invariants.rationale: The method dereferences node and its fields/methods, so node must not be null at this point.
At method exit, either node.parent was not null (causing early return via recursion), or it was null and the method continued.
If rootNodes.removeValue(node, true) returns false, the method returns immediately; only if it is true does execution proceed, and this is only possible if node.parent == null.
